text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. While walking through the 
academy, I ran into Daitaku Helios looking 
unusually down...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah, *sob*! Listen to this, Trainieee!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hello everyone, this is the Beautification 
Committee. Thank you so much for your 
cooperation with Campus Beautification 
Week!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Right away, we assigned cleaning zones to 
everyone who gathered—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Okaay! Proposal for Flowertchi! How about 
we settle who cleans where with some 
party-people rock-paper-scissors!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
P-Party-people rock-paper-scissors...? Um, 
what kind of rock-paper-scissors is that?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: This is rock☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's cut it together with a 
snip☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It feels totally paaaarty☆★! With the hype 
turned way up, cleaning's gonna be a 
blast, no doubt!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a real match! Winners pick 
their spot! Losers get the leftovers in 
this deathmatch☆ Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha! That's hilarious~~! Being the 
only solo fan for the last member is 
actually pretty rare ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pyyeeeeh! No way-! Being alone sucks so 
bad, I can't take this dead silence~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I seriously can't take this anymore! In 
just one minute, I got totally swallowed 
up by a massive wave of loneliness~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Please, Trainer-pi~! Do it with me~~!! I'm 
so lonely I could sprout 
lonely-shrooms~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no reason to refuse when they're 
asking this desperately. To make cleaning 
up fun, the first thing to do is...
choice_data_list: Let's start with the tough weeding.

Scrubbing the mud off the walls has me 
hyped!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Awoo! Seriously?! I'm honestly pretty 
bored already!
choice_data_list:
That's because you were doing it all 
alone, right?

That's because you were doing it all 
alone, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa, are you an angel? Talk about not 
having to carry the burden alone, huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uhee, that really packs a punch. But I'm 
not lonely, so I'm happy and having fun♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I mean, isn't Trainer-pi trembling?
choice_data_list: My legs... are really feeling the burn...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No way, for real?! Ahahaha! Talk about 
hardcore training!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm getting pumped up! Let's 
both aim to get totally ripped☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally got this! Together, the ultimate 
buff-leg duo is officially born, awww 
yeah☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...AHAHAHAHA! No twist at all--!! *Pfft*! 
Bwahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Apparently something tickled her funny 
bone. While impressed by her ability to 
instantly laugh in any situation, I 
continued with the work—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy! Super fresh and sparklyâ Isn't 
this place, like, totally Insta-worthy?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! Isn't it insane?! That was 
so much fun! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaah! Love the hype! Bring me some 
water, would ya? ☆★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
C-Cold! Water splashed on my legs! Ugh, 
I'm all wet!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if we're gonna get soaked anyway, 
shouldn't we just wear swimsuits?! Come 
on! Trainie, go grab your swimsuit too!
choice_data_list:
More importantly, let's put on some hot 
music!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oho, hype things up with music, you say?! 
Alright, lemme put on something hot, hold 
on!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyyy~ââ ALOHAAA----!! SAY COME ON!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making sure Daitaku Helios wouldn't catch 
a cold, we kept up the hype and pushed 
through cleaning the wall—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy! Super fresh and sparklyâ Isn't 
this place, like, totally Insta-worthy?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! Isn't it insane?! That was 
so much fun! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Trai-pi, thanks a bunch for totally 
coming♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Man, I went and called it a 'serious 
showdown' myself, y'know? Talk about super 
embarrassing afterwards~

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then Trainer-pi pulled up, right? And 
before I knew it, my mood was totally 
hyped up, y'know??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Trainy-P is crazy strong! Are they 
seriously the GOAT!?" —is totally what I 
thought!!
choice_data_list:
Great! Just let me know if you need 
anything else.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then I've got one right away! Can 
I ask one last favor!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Alright, gather round, gather round~~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios! I finished early, so I came to 
help—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Fufufu♪ Looks like good friends came 
by.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Daitaku Helios throwing her arm 
around my shoulder, we snapped a photo 
squeezed tightly into the frame. Above 
all, I was just glad to see her having so 
much fun.
